about.h2: A neighbourhood gym where the owner still coaches.
about.p1: Max Fitness Gym has been part of Nyay Khand since 2000. Members come for the equipment and stay for the people: trainers who notice your form, remember your name and push you just enough.
about.p2: Whether you're lifting for the first time or chasing a new personal best, the floor is set up to help you train safely and keep coming back.
about.beginners: Beginners guided from the first session
about.photoMain: Wide view of the training floor
about.photoInset: A trainer guiding a member's form

facilities.h2: Everything you need, nothing you don't.

functional.body: Battle ropes, step platforms and agility cones on an open wooden floor.

boxing.body: Heavy bags for conditioning and stress-busting rounds.

beginner.q: I've never been to a gym. Is that okay?
beginner.a: Absolutely. Most of our members started as beginners. Trainers will show you the machines and plan your first weeks.

payment.a: Online by UPI, card or netbanking when you sign up, or at reception by cash or UPI.

selfie.q: Why do you ask for a selfie?
selfie.a: It's your member photo so our staff recognise you. If you agree, the attendance phone at reception can also mark your attendance automatically. You can say no and staff will mark it manually.

refund.a: [Owner refund policy]. See our Refund & cancellation policy.

bring.a: Water bottle, a small towel and clean indoor shoes.

personalTraining.a: Yes. Personal training is ₹3,000 a month and includes a diet plan.
